policy: Allow infinitives and documented ordinary singular/invariant nouns or base adjectives. Exclude words supported only as finite verb forms in any tense/mood/person, gerunds or participles. A lexicalized noun/base-adjective homograph requires its own reviewed source sense; spelling suffixes never decide eligibility.

TOMAR.sense: to drink; to have a drink

COPIAR.sense: to copy down; to write down

COMETER.sense: to commit (an act); to make (a mistake)
